A indicação perto de um personagem mostr: The prompt near a character shows the available action. Use the indicated key or button to start talking.
O nome identifica quem está falando. A c: The name identifies the speaker. Their words appear at the bottom; use Continue to advance. Story missions may start or finish when the conversation ends.
Ver missões abre os trabalhos disponívei: View missions shows available jobs and your current objective. Only buttons perform actions. Cancel mission stops the current job.
Informações reúne pistas e registros da: Information collects story clues and records for reading. Reading these entries does not start or cancel missions.
Avisos breves confirmam ações e resultad: Brief notices confirm actions and results. The current objective shows your next step and can also be checked in the journal.
Maciota conversa sobre a história quando: Maciota talks about the story when a step is available. On other visits, choose View missions or Information from the compact menu.
